correctness.rationale: Preimages of I_t under bad left, good left, and common right branches yield exactly m(t)=q m(t/ell)+j(t). Stationary density is locally Lipschitz at the injection points 1/4 and 3/4 by the primary theorem, hence j(t)=J2^-t/4+O(2^-2t) with J>0 and differentiable remainder. The convergent F(t)=m(t)+sum_{k>=1}q^-k j(ell^k t) obeys F(ell t)=qF(t), and F>0,F'<0, so both log-periodic mass and derivative profiles are positive. First tail term gives the exponential correction; direct differentiation yields density error O(2^(-(ell-1)t)). Independent 18 rational branch identities passed, not a proof of invariant density existence.
